# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V8032 dependency_effects_exceeded"
description: "A dependency's declared ceiling (its [package] effects, recorded in sakura.lock) lists std effects that the consumer's line for it does not accept (RFC 0003 §5.1, experimental)."
---

An error from the `package` phase. `sakura explain V8032` prints this explanation offline.

A dependency's declared ceiling (its `[package] effects`, recorded in `sakura.lock`) lists std
effects that the consumer's line for it does not accept (RFC 0003 §5.1, experimental). The
`effects` on a `[dependencies]` line is what the consumer agrees the dependency, and everything
it calls, may require; absent, it is `[]`, so a dependency with any ceiling needs the line. A new
version or an edited `path` dependency that widens its ceiling stops compiling here until the
line is edited. The suggested fix rewrites the line with the dependency's ceiling; it is an
authority change and never applied automatically.

Wrong:

```toml
[dependencies]
stamp = { path = "../stamp" }   # stamp declares effects = ["Clock"]
```

Fixed:

```toml
[dependencies]
stamp = { path = "../stamp", effects = ["Clock"] }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V8032_dependency_effects_exceeded/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V8032_dependency_effects_exceeded/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

`main.sak`:

```sakura
// RFC 0003 §5.1: a dependency whose ceiling the consumer's line does not accept is `V8032` at
// that line, with a suggested fix (an authority change) that adds `effects = ["Clock"]`.
import stamp/lib

pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Clock, Console} { Console.print("{lib.now()}") }
```

`sakura.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"

[dependencies]
stamp = { path = "stamp" }
```
